newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber Cisco details.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber Cisco details.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Paul Weinstein said the near-term performance of Cisco Systems Inc could remain weak "as estimate revisions look increasingly likely" amid general uncertainty in the networking market.

-- The analyst said that as a result he had downgraded the stock to neutral from buy and cut his earnings estimates by $0.02 or $0.03 for both the third quarter ending in April and the fourth quarter that closes in July.
-- He said estimate cuts were based on a "more competitive macro environment, tougher switching and router comparisons" and lack of improvement in previously-known negative factors.
